name: HarfBuzz

source.verification: Release asset of harfbuzz/harfbuzz 15.2.0 (2026-11-19); its SHA-256 matches the GitHub release asset digest. Imported files are the library sources and headers under src/ (.cc, .hh, .h) and COPYING; tests, utilities, docs and build scripts are not imported.

licenses.upstreamExpression: COPYING (HarfBuzz 'Old MIT' license, with the copyright holders listed there)

pragmaDirectives.text: #pragma GCC diagnostic error   "-Wuninitialized" // A warning under gcc; see below
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wdangling-pointer" // Trigerred by hb_decycler_node_t().
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wpacked" // Erratic impl in clang
#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wc++11-compat" // only gcc raises it

notes: Text shaping for the font backend (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.2). The only Rocks consumer is the ClientOnly module TextLayoutBackend. Translation units: the upstream amalgamation harfbuzz.cc (with hb-ft through HAVE_FREETYPE) and hb-icu.cc, which the amalgamation does not include; HAVE_ICU_BUILTIN with HB_NO_UCD makes the ICU Unicode functions the default (without HB_NO_UCD the built-in UCD tables come first) (decision FD15, the same as the UE 5.8 HarfBuzz 12.2.0 build).

Allocation: hb_malloc_impl, hb_calloc_impl, hb_realloc_impl and hb_free_impl name RocksHarfBuzzMalloc, RocksHarfBuzzCalloc, RocksHarfBuzzRealloc and RocksHarfBuzzFree (extern "C", declared by hb.hh). The module that links HarfBuzz defines them over a Rocks allocator; HarfBuzz never calls the CRT heap.

HB_NO_GETENV (behavior does not depend on HB_SHAPER_LIST and the other environment variables), HB_NO_OPEN (no hb_blob_create_from_file: the engine passes font bytes from memory) and HB_NO_BUFFER_SERIALIZE (no debug text serialization) are upstream configuration switches (CONFIG.md); they also remove the CRT getenv, fopen, mbstowcs and strcpy calls the engine warning rules reject.
No RTTI and no exceptions (HarfBuzz does not use either).

modifications.reason: strncpy copies a byte string of known length that is shorter than the buffer and is followed by buf[len] = '\0', so hb_memcpy gives the same C string; the Microsoft CRT marks strncpy deprecated and the engine warning rules reject -Wdeprecated-declarations.
